## The problem

<!-- What cannot be done today, or what goes wrong, for whom?

## Proposed change

<!-- The smallest change that would solve it. Name the scope area:

## Fit with the house rules

<!-- CONTRIBUTING.md lists them; the short version:
     - standard library only — does this need any dependency?
     - host boundary — does the change preserve permissions and bounded
       recovery from ordinary model/tool errors?
     - seed simplicity — how much code or instruction burden does this add
       for small local models? Could it live in evaluations/ or examples/?
     - app-specific integrations are kept outside the core until the
       post-v1 extension library; is this one of those? -->

## Evidence plan

<!-- What checks are proportionate to the change? For model-behavior claims,
     what frozen tasks, budgets and repeats would make the result
     believable — and what result would make you withdraw the proposal? -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Other shapes you weighed, and why this one. "Do nothing" is a
